level.description: Signed SI text matching captured probe units, optionally m/u/µ/μ prefix with explicit unit (for example 2.5 V or 1 mA); finite magnitude at most 1e12.

limit.description: Omit or zero for eight arrivals; otherwise 1–100.

second_level.description: Optional second level in captured probe units; omitted/empty disables transition timing. Distinct from level after SI normalization. Both levels are ordered low/high; first complete observed low-to-high and high-to-low traversals use saved brackets, independently of arrival filtering/pages. Returning to the starting threshold aborts an unfinished traversal.

preconditions: Retained completed capture and a captured probe; DC/empty intervals can yield zero arrivals
Set ID must match selected recording; empty probe clears only with empty second_level, level 0, both directions and zero interval/page fields
effects: Rising: before < level and after >= level; falling: before > level and after <= level; equal plateaus do not repeatedly trigger
Only adjacent exact saved rows wholly inside strict interval; duplicates retain edge order; no interpolation, resampling or hidden-transition guarantee
First same-direction spacing bounds subtract observed sample brackets; not a certification of periodic behavior
First high/low widths use consecutive opposite observed arrivals; first cycle requires consecutive rising/falling/rising. Pulse/cycle summaries use both directions regardless of list filter/page

Cycle high_fraction bounds retain the shared rising-time dependence: (fall.before-rise.after)/(next.after-rise.after) through (fall.after-rise.before)/(next.before-rise.before). Omitted if minimum cycle duration is not positive; reason explains why

Optional second_level enables sampled low/high transition timing. Levels must differ after SI normalization; unfinished traversal resets on an opposite arrival at its starting threshold. No monotonicity or hidden-transition guarantee
Query is pure; set caches a bounded derived page as session/view state; selection/reopen clears; no live/history/project/solver changes

errors.when: Invalid level/unit/direction/interval/page or missing required fields
Set ID differs from selected capture

completion.mode: bounded in-memory scan of at most 4096 saved rows; no worker/file IO
